column1: Toss the squash, sweet potato, 2 tbsp oil, sage, garlic, and half the pancetta on a baking tray. Roast 20–30 minutes until starting to brown.
Meanwhile, melt the butter with the remaining oil in a saucepan and soften the onion until translucent.
Add the rest of the pancetta and cook until browned.
Pour in the wine and let it reduce a little, then add the barley, stock, and Parmigiano rind.
Simmer about 30 minutes, stirring now and then and adding more stock if it gets dry.
Stir in most of the roasted vegetables and pancetta, keeping some aside for topping, and cook about 10 minutes more until the barley is tender.
Take off the heat, discard the rind, and stir in the crème fraîche and grated Parmigiano. Season to taste.
Serve topped with the reserved vegetables and pancetta, extra Parmigiano, and sage.
